verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Numeral that users can hand tasks to. The MCP server exposes the account to external clients such as Claude Code or Cursor, the Claude skills teach outside coding agents how to integrate, and "AI product classification" is a single automated feature rather than an assistant. These are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
